title: Rainbow Six Mobile shuts down January 15, 2027 📱
subject: rainbowsixmobile
description:
Did you ever play Rainbow Six Mobile? 👇

Ubisoft announced on October 8, 2026 that Rainbow Six Mobile will remain available until January 15, 2027, less than a year after its global launch on iOS and Android in February 2026. The next season still launches as planned, and the team moves on to other long-term projects.

Sources: Ubisoft ("Rainbow Six Mobile update: message from the devs", Oct 8, 2026), VGC (Oct 9, 2026), SiegeGG (Oct 8, 2026), KitGuru
tags: rainbow six mobile end of service

scenes.text: Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down.
Ubisoft announced on October 8 that the game will stay available until January 15, 2027.
That's less than a year after its global launch on iOS and Android in February 2026.
The developers called it a difficult decision and thanked everyone who played.
The next season still launches as planned, and the team will move on to other long-term projects.
The shutdown only affects the mobile game, not Rainbow Six Siege.
